caption: The four rows are the four equivalence classes C1–C4, holding the nine boundary ages. 0 and 121 are rejected, and 60 is where the senior discount starts.

spec.title: Age 1–120: classes and edges
spec.aria: An array groups the nine test ages into four classes: C1 invalid at 0, C2 accepted at 1, 2 and 59, C3 discount at 60, 61, 119 and 120, and C4 invalid at 121.
